parsed.justification: The posting title contains 'Software Engineer', its departments list Engineering, and its location and offices are Boston, MA, which matches the résumé location. The content mentions at least two résumé skills (Python, FastAPI, RAG) and requires 3+ years, which is within the résumé's experience_years of 3. The title has no excluded words, and the content describes a salaried role that is not an internship, not contract-only, and requires no relocation, so none of the résumé exclusions apply.

The title 'Sr. Lead Software Engineer' matches the Software Engineer phrase in target_roles, the department is Engineering, the location is Boston, MA, and the content mentions at least two résumé skills (Python, FastAPI, RAG). However, the content requires 8+ years of experience, more than the 3-year maximum tied to experience_years (Condition 5 fails). The title also contains the excluded whole word 'Lead' (Condition 6 fails).

The title contains 'Software Engineer', the department is Engineering, and the location and office are Boston, so conditions 1-3 pass.
